findings.highlight: why does everything I put away disappear
findings.evidenceJa: 仕舞った筈の物がなくなってる
findings.governingReading: Rin complains that the thing she knows she put away has gone missing in this house.
findings.explanation: Everything and disappear turn one frustrated complaint into a general claim that the house repeatedly loses all stored objects.

findings.highlight: she always messes up her preparations
findings.evidenceJa: その準備がうまく行かないところ
findings.governingReading: Shirou finds it characteristic that Rin executes tasks perfectly yet has trouble with their preparation.
findings.explanation: Always messes up changes a situational weakness into sweeping habitual incompetence.

findings.highlight: She throws away the Boston bag
findings.evidenceJa: ボストンバックを放り投げ
findings.governingReading: Rin tosses aside the Boston bag she has thoroughly rummaged through.
findings.explanation: Throws away denotes disposal rather than an irritated physical toss within the room.

findings.highlight: something that doesn’t exist anymore or something that’s already lost
findings.evidenceJa: この世にない物、とっくに失われた物
findings.governingReading: Rin distinguishes an object absent from this world from one lost long ago.
findings.explanation: Doesn’t exist anymore makes both cases temporal loss and collapses the broader absence condition.

findings.highlight: Normal magic uses things that are somewhere in this world.
findings.evidenceJa: 世界のどこかにある実物を目の前に持ってきて使う
findings.governingReading: Rin says ordinary magecraft brings a real thing from somewhere in the world before the caster and uses it.
findings.explanation: The English omits the act of bringing the real object into the caster’s presence.

findings.evidenceJa: 投影魔術は人間のイメージを彩色する
findings.governingReading: Projection magecraft colors a human mental image, contrasting its fabricated product with ordinary use of real objects.
findings.explanation: Uses removes the coloring operation and weakens the paired theory metaphor.

findings.highlight: an illusion that violates this world
findings.governingReading: The forbidden illusion erodes or encroaches upon present reality.
findings.explanation: Violates states a generic transgression and removes the image of fantasy physically consuming reality.

findings.evidenceJa: だあー、と一気に遠坂はまくし立てる
findings.governingReading: Rin rattles the entire explanation off in one rapid barrage.
findings.explanation: Explains it all removes her speed, breathless delivery, and the sound-like lead-in.
